dataset_identity.title: Conveyor Belt Damage Detection Dataset (COCO format)
dataset_identity.annotation_format: COCO JSON (Bounding Boxes: [x, y, width, height])

scientific_domain_limitations.disclaimer: CRITICAL SCIENTIFIC CORRECTION: The dataset contains exactly 6 annotated damage categories: Belt Joint, Large Tear, Small Tear, Large Hole, Small Hole, and general damage. It does NOT explicitly contain a class called 'Crack'. The system must NOT claim detection of cracks unless an actual crack-labeled dataset or fine-tuned model is added in a subsequent revision.
authorized_uses: Conveyor belt surface tear detection (Large Tear, Small Tear)
Conveyor belt perforation/puncture detection (Large Hole, Small Hole)
Conveyor belt joint/splice optical boundary identification (Belt Joint)
Benchmarking object detection algorithms on industrial rubber conveyor belts
prohibited_claims: Claiming the model detects microscopic cracks without a crack-specific labeled dataset
Renaming the 'damage' or 'tear' classes to 'crack' without scientific annotation basis
Claiming field-certified safety compliance based solely on laboratory/benchmark imagery

test.role: Strictly held-out evaluation set. Never used in training or hyperparameter tuning.
